name: Matutinal-Shoal
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around an exposed planetary core, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.

Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
